points.K22: 屏障有局限，总有剩余风险
points.K26: 新建动物设施，参与会谈
points.K44: 安全员靠什么发挥作用

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼大厅，身旁立着一块空白岗位牌，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a laboratory building lobby beside a blank job sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，聊聊生物安全员。
overlay: 生物安全员：职责与担当

shots.scene: 欣欣手里托着一个人形图标，周围环绕许多小图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a person icon surrounded by many small floating icons.
shots.narration: 他一个人，要懂的事真不少。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验室门口被王老师叫住，手里拿着一叠空白表格
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops the young male student at a lab door; he holds a stack of blank forms.
shots.narration: 阿杰被王老师拦下补登记。

shots.scene: 阿杰小声嘀咕，表情不服气
shots.prompt_en: The young male student mutters with an unconvinced look.
shots.narration: 安全员，不就是来找麻烦的？

shots.scene: 小研拍拍阿杰肩膀，笑着摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pats the young male student on the shoulder and shakes her head with a smile.
shots.narration: 小研说：你还真不了解他。

shots.scene: 王老师招手，示意大家坐下
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator waves everyone to sit down at a small table.
shots.narration: 王老师：来，我讲讲我的工作。

shots.scene: 一个由建筑、规章、设备、人组成的拼图，人形那块发光
shots.prompt_en: A jigsaw puzzle made of a building piece, a rule book piece, an equipment piece and a glowing person piece. No people.
shots.narration: 安全体系里，安全员是“人”的部分。

shots.scene: 王老师把一本空白政策手册翻开，指向实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank policy handbook and points to a laboratory icon.
shots.narration: 把单位的政策，落到每间实验室。

shots.scene: 王老师身后书架上有生物、法规、操作三类空白书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands before a bookshelf with three groups of blank books marked by a cell icon, a gavel icon and a hand icon.
shots.narration: 懂生物学，懂法规，也懂操作。

shots.scene: 白板上画着三个图标：心形、规则本、职责清单
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with three icons: a heart, a rule book and a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 今天讲三件事：文化、合规、职责。

shots.scene: 一本空白生物安全手册，第一章的位置空着
shots.prompt_en: A blank biosafety manual opened at an empty first chapter. No people.
shots.narration: 学完，能写出手册的“职责”一章。

shots.scene: 王老师指向一座小楼，楼上升起盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a small building with a shield rising above it.
shots.narration: 再把安全文化，带回自己单位。

shots.scene: 小研拿起笔，在空白本子上写写画画
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes notes in a blank notebook with a pen.
shots.narration: 先想想：安全员该做什么？

shots.scene: 一张空白清单，后面画了一个对照的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with an arrow pointing to a second blank list for comparison. No people.
shots.narration: 写下来，等讲完再对照。

shots.scene: 四个圆圈围成环：行为、信念、价值、符号四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four circles in a ring with icons of a walking person, a lightbulb, a heart and a flag around a central circle. No people.
shots.narration: 文化，是行为、信念、价值和符号。

shots.scene: 小研进门时自然地洗手、穿实验服，动作流畅
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student enters the lab and naturally washes her hands and puts on a lab coat in one smooth motion.
shots.narration: 好习惯，做到不用想。

shots.scene: 老周示范，阿杰跟着学，箭头从老人指向年轻人
shots.prompt_en: The older man demonstrates putting on gloves while the young male student copies him; an arrow points from the older man to the student.
shots.narration: 靠沟通和模仿，一代代传下去。

shots.scene: 王老师自己也戴好护目镜和手套进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator himself puts on safety goggles and gloves before entering the lab.
shots.narration: 要求别人做的，自己先做到。

shots.scene: 王老师进门不戴防护，旁边学生模仿，整幅图打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an adult entering a lab without protection and a student copying him, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 嘴上一套，手上一套，没人信。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着镜子里的自己
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at its own reflection in a mirror.
shots.narration: 别等别人先改，从我开始。

shots.scene: 王老师站在前面，一排人跟在后面
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks in front with a line of researchers following behind.
shots.narration: 安全员，就是单位里的榜样。

shots.scene: 一本规则本和一个对勾，旁边是天平
shots.prompt_en: A rule book with a check mark next to a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 合规，就是遵守规则、标准和法律。

shots.scene: 画面一分为二：左边法槌图标，右边单位愿景旗帜图标
shots.prompt_en: A split image: a gavel icon on the left and an institutional flag icon on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 守国家法规，是外部合规。

shots.scene: 单位的空白使命牌和质量方针文件
shots.prompt_en: A blank mission plaque and a blank quality policy document on a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 守单位的方针和制度，是内部合规。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白清单上逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator ticks items on a blank checklist one by one.
shots.narration: 问问自己：我们单位遵从什么？

shots.scene: 地球、国旗、指南书、伦理天平、标准证书五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a globe, a national flag, a guideline book, an ethics scale and a standards certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 法律、指南、伦理、规范、标准。

shots.scene: 老周翻看本单位的空白制度汇编
shots.prompt_en: The older man browses a blank binder of institutional rules.
shots.narration: 翻一翻制度，就知道合规到哪一步。

shots.scene: 三个图标：灯塔、拍板、听诊器，箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: Three connected icons: a lighthouse, a clapperboard and a stethoscope, linked by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 意识、行动、反省，缺一不可。

shots.scene: 四格循环：计划、执行、检查、改进
shots.prompt_en: A four-step circular cycle diagram with four blank segments and arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 也就是计划、执行、检查、改进。

shots.scene: 循环向上螺旋上升
shots.prompt_en: The cycle diagram spirals upward like a staircase. No people.
shots.narration: 一圈圈转，质量一点点提高。

shots.scene: 王老师新到岗，抱着纸箱站在办公室门口
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator arrives at a new office holding a cardboard box.
shots.narration: 新来的安全员，从哪里下手？

shots.scene: 单位使命牌上嵌进一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon being inserted into a blank institutional mission plaque. No people.
shots.narration: 先把安全写进单位的使命和政策。

shots.scene: 政策文件放进法规大书的轮廓里
shots.prompt_en: A blank policy document fitting inside the outline of a large law book. No people.
shots.narration: 政策要在法律范围之内。

shots.scene: 一座小楼周围有社区和居民图标
shots.prompt_en: A small building surrounded by community house icons. No people.
shots.narration: 安全，也是对社会负责。

shots.scene: 金字塔三层，每层有一个发光的小人
shots.prompt_en: A three-level pyramid with a glowing person icon on each level. No people.
shots.narration: 找到各层愿意推动的人，支持他们。

shots.scene: 老周皱眉看空白账本，钱袋图标压在盾牌上
shots.prompt_en: The older man frowns at a blank ledger while a money bag icon presses down on a shield icon.
shots.narration: 如果领导觉得安全是负担呢？

shots.scene: 规章被硬塞给一群人，人们转身，图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a rule book being forced on a group who turn away, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 硬压规定，没有用。

shots.scene: 王老师给老周看一张简单的风险图示，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows the older man a simple risk diagram and the older man nods.
shots.narration: 先让领导明白，为什么要管。

shots.scene: 王老师在会议室向大家讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains to a group of researchers in a meeting room.
shots.narration: 再在全单位沟通开来。

shots.scene: 培训教室里，阿杰和小研认真听课
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student listen attentively in a training classroom.
shots.narration: 最后靠培训，真正落实。

shots.scene: 三个空白工牌并排，上面是同一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank badges side by side, each with the same shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 叫法不同，干的是同一件事。

shots.scene: 王老师手里拿着一个写着空白的任务卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank task card.
shots.narration: 责任，首先是有事必须去管。

shots.scene: 整齐的空白记录夹，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A neat stack of blank record folders with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 其次要能问责，靠记录说话。

shots.scene: 老周把一枚印章交到王老师手里
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands an official stamp to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 还要有授权，能独立作决定。

shots.scene: 一棵小树逐渐长大的三格图
shots.prompt_en: Three panels showing a small sapling growing into a tree. No people.
shots.narration: 这些本事，要一点点积累。

shots.scene: 王老师看显微镜下的细胞图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator looks at cell icons through a microscope.
shots.narration: 第一，要懂微生物和细胞生物学。

shots.scene: 老周拿着空白申请单，指向普通实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a blank application form and points at an ordinary laboratory icon.
shots.narration: 有人想在普通实验室培养病原。

shots.scene: 王老师拿出一张空白问卷，上面有问号图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator takes out a blank questionnaire with question mark icons.
shots.narration: 安全员先问：什么因子？几级实验室？

shots.scene: 评估、措施、检查三个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up in order: a magnifier, a shield and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险，定措施，再看效果。

shots.scene: 王老师递出一张空白问卷和一份措施清单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands over a blank questionnaire and a measures list.
shots.narration: 设计问卷，提出缓解措施。

shots.scene: DNA 双螺旋图标，旁边一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix icon next to a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，要懂基因工程和生物技术。

shots.scene: 一个病原图标变化后出现问号和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A generic microbe icon changes shape, with a question mark and a magnifier beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 改造可能改变病原的特性。

shots.scene: 王老师对着一本基因工程书认真思考
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator studies a genetics book thoughtfully.
shots.narration: 安全员必须懂得其中的风险。

shots.scene: 生物危害、化学瓶、辐射三个警示图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons side by side: a biohazard warning sign, a chemical bottle with a hazard pictogram and an ionizing radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，不只有生物危害。

shots.scene: 化学品柜和放射性物质柜各有标志
shots.prompt_en: A chemical storage cabinet and a radioactive material cabinet, each with its warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 致突变试剂、放射性物质，也要管。

shots.scene: 王老师在白板上画问号，旁边一个微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator draws a question mark on a whiteboard next to a microbe icon.
shots.narration: 什么是生物因子，怎么分类？

shots.scene: 白板上的问号旁出现一个分组表格轮廓
shots.prompt_en: A blank grouping table outline appears beside the question mark on the whiteboard. No people.
shots.narration: 这是安全员必须弄清的问题。

shots.scene: 十个人形图标，其中六个变红
shots.prompt_en: Ten person icons in a row, six of them turned red. No people.
shots.narration: 十个人用同一因子，六人感染。

shots.scene: 实验室图标和户外树木图标，中间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory icon and an outdoor tree icon with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 这种因子，外面环境里也有。

shots.scene: 王老师翻阅空白记录和日历
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews blank records next to a calendar.
shots.narration: 是在实验室感染的，还是之前就有？

shots.scene: 体检记录和工作记录两条时间线对比
shots.prompt_en: Two blank timelines side by side, one with a medical icon and one with a lab icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要查健康记录，也查工作记录。

shots.scene: 王老师和校医并肩站着，旁边听诊器图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands beside a doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope icon.
shots.narration: 第四，和医务部门一起合作。

shots.scene: 健康档案和预防用的疫苗图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank health record folder next to a vaccine vial icon. No people.
shots.narration: 做好预防和健康监测。

shots.scene: 几只不同的手举起来，各有不同表情图标
shots.prompt_en: Several raised hands with different small face icons above them. No people.
shots.narration: 第五，人的因素：每个人都不一样。

shots.scene: 阿杰打哈欠，旁边一个出错的感叹号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student yawns with an exclamation mark icon beside him.
shots.narration: 疲劳、马虎，都会出差错。

shots.scene: 王老师耐心地和阿杰谈话
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks patiently with the young male student.
shots.narration: 要会影响人的行为和风险意识。

shots.section_title: 屏障有局限，总有剩余风险
shots.scene: 生物安全柜图标和实验室房间图标，标一、二
shots.prompt_en: A biosafety cabinet icon and a laboratory room icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 第六，懂防护屏障：一级和二级。
overlay: 屏障有局限，总有剩余风险

shots.section_title: 屏障有局限，总有剩余风险
shots.scene: 层层盾牌后面仍有一个小小的风险点
shots.prompt_en: Several layered shields with one small remaining risk dot behind them. No people.
shots.narration: 措施再多，也总有剩余风险。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白问卷和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank questionnaire and a magnifier.
shots.narration: 第七，用问卷做风险评估。

shots.scene: 倒三角控制层级图，从上到下五格
shots.prompt_en: An inverted triangle diagram with five blank layers. No people.
shots.narration: 按控制层级，挑合适的措施。

shots.scene: 王老师向老周递交一份空白建议书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank recommendation report to the older man.
shots.narration: 再把建议，交给负责人。

shots.scene: 一栋实验楼外面是树林和小鸟
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory building with a forest and birds outside. No people.
shots.narration: 第八，保护环境。

shots.scene: 动物与人之间的双向箭头，旁边一个转基因植物图标
shots.prompt_en: A two-way arrow between an animal icon and a person icon, next to a modified plant icon. No people.
shots.narration: 人兽共患因子、转基因生物，要防逃逸。

shots.scene: 王老师打电话请教专家
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator makes a phone call to consult an expert.
shots.narration: 不懂的，及时请专家。

shots.scene: 王老师和老李一起看空白图纸
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer study blank blueprints together.
shots.narration: 第九，要看得懂设施图纸。

shots.scene: 通风管道和空调机组的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A schematic of ventilation ducts and an air handling unit. No people.
shots.narration: 懂通风空调，懂基本布局。

shots.scene: 一排图标：起吊、验收、扳手、拆除
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a crane, an inspection clipboard, a wrench and a demolition sign. No people.
shots.narration: 从建造、验收、维护，到停用。

shots.section_title: 新建动物设施，参与会谈
shots.scene: 会议桌旁，王老师、老李和两位工程顾问开会
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer sit at a meeting table with two consultants in suits.
shots.narration: 单位要建三级生物安全动物设施。

shots.section_title: 新建动物设施，参与会谈
shots.scene: 王老师举手提问，桌上有空白图纸
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator raises a hand to ask a question over blank blueprints.
shots.narration: 安全员要代表单位，向工程方提问。

shots.section_title: 新建动物设施，参与会谈
shots.scene: 法规书和政府大楼图标，旁边一个对话框
shots.prompt_en: A law book and a government building icon with a blank speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 还要回应主管部门的法规要求。

shots.section_title: 新建动物设施，参与会谈
shots.scene: 审批印章盖在空白建设方案上
shots.prompt_en: An approval stamp lands on a blank construction plan. No people.
shots.narration: 这些，都是安全员的分内事。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜、离心机、高压灭菌器三台设备
shots.prompt_en: A biosafety cabinet, a centrifuge and an autoclave side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 第十，懂实验室里的设备。

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰演示生物安全柜的开关面板
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows the young male student the blank control panel of a biosafety cabinet.
shots.narration: 自己会用，才能教别人用。

shots.scene: 六个图标排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a column: a shopping cart, a hand with a document, a toolbox, a check mark, a certificate and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 选型、正确使用、安装。

shots.scene: 后三个图标放大
shots.prompt_en: Three icons enlarged: a check mark, a certificate and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 验证、认证、维护。

shots.scene: 每台设备旁一个空白档案夹
shots.prompt_en: Each piece of equipment has a blank file folder next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 每一项，都要有档案。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里规范操作，台面整洁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works neatly inside a biosafety cabinet with a tidy work surface.
shots.narration: 第十一，良好微生物操作技术。

shots.scene: 无菌操作、高压灭菌、消毒擦拭三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a flame-free sterile tool, an autoclave and a wiping cloth with a spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 无菌操作、灭菌、去污，样样到位。

shots.scene: 王老师根据空白评估表，从架子上挑选防护用品
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator picks protective equipment from a shelf while reading a blank assessment form.
shots.narration: 第十二，按风险评估选防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰试戴新护目镜，王老师询问是否合适
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries on new safety goggles while the safety administrator asks if they fit.
shots.narration: 新用品引进，问题要提前想到。

shots.scene: 两瓶消毒剂，一瓶贴着低价标签图标
shots.prompt_en: Two disinfectant bottles, one with a low price tag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三，有人想换便宜的消毒剂。

shots.scene: 王老师对比两份空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator compares two blank product sheets.
shots.narration: 先确认：它对这类因子有效吗？

shots.scene: 空白规程上画着一个计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure sheet with a timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 规程里写明作用时间。

shots.scene: 四个图标：分类桶、暂存间、转运车、灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: sorting bins, a storage room, a transport cart and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四，废物分类、暂存、转运、处置。

shots.scene: 灭菌指示条变色，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A sterilization indicator strip changing color with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 方案里还要有效果验证。

shots.scene: 化学溢洒、生物溢洒、火焰、闪电四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a chemical spill, a biological spill, a flame and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五，预想各种突发情况。

shots.scene: 王老师在白板上写应急流程框图
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator draws a blank emergency flowchart on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 提前定好方案，出事不慌。

shots.scene: 放大镜在一叠记录上移动
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier moving across a stack of blank records. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六，出了事故要调查。

shots.scene: 一条链条追溯到起点，起点加上一把锁
shots.prompt_en: A chain traced back to its start, where a padlock is added. No people.
shots.narration: 找到源头，加上控制，防止再犯。

shots.scene: 齿轮组互相咬合，中间一个人形
shots.prompt_en: Interlocking gears with a person icon in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七，让安全计划真正运转。

shots.scene: 设施、制度、防护、人四块拼在一起
shots.prompt_en: Four puzzle pieces with facility, rule book, protective gear and person icons fitting together. No people.
shots.narration: 各项控制和人，环环相扣。

shots.scene: 王老师站在讲台前，小研、阿杰在台下
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at a podium; the female graduate student and the young male student sit in the audience.
shots.narration: 第十八，懂培训。新到岗，先培训。

shots.scene: 不同对象的三组人形图标，各配不同课本
shots.prompt_en: Three groups of person icons, each with a different blank textbook. No people.
shots.narration: 按对象设计，培训后还要检验。

shots.scene: 王老师一边讲，一边自己在本子上记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches while also writing notes in his own notebook.
shots.narration: 教别人的过程，也在教自己。

shots.scene: 王老师分别对老周、阿杰、外来访客讲话
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator speaks in turn to the older man, the young male student and a visitor.
shots.narration: 第十九，讲得清楚，说得服人。

shots.scene: 天平两端平衡
shots.prompt_en: A perfectly balanced scale. No people.
shots.narration: 对事不对人，不带偏见。

shots.scene: 几个人对话气泡里是不同的图标
shots.prompt_en: Several speech bubbles with different icons in each. No people.
shots.narration: 体察不同背景的人怎么看风险。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表巡查实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through a lab holding a blank inspection checklist.
shots.narration: 第二十，审核和检查。

shots.scene: 检查表上一项打叉，一项画灯泡
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with one item crossed out and one item marked with a lightbulb. No people.
shots.narration: 找出不符合项，也找改进点。

shots.scene: 转运箱、飞机、卡车三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sealed transport box, an airplane and a truck. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十一，运输与进出口。

shots.scene: 三层包装示意，外面贴着生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A triple packaging diagram with a biohazard warning sign on the outer box. No people.
shots.narration: 包装、标识、运输方式，都要合规。

shots.scene: 一摞空白法规书，最上面一本有国徽轮廓
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank law books, the top one with a national emblem outline. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十二，熟悉法规框架。

shots.scene: 一本大书和一个地球图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A large book beside a globe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 国家国际法规、标准、公约都要懂。

shots.scene: 人形和小鼠图标放在天平两侧
shots.prompt_en: A person icon and a mouse icon on two sides of a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十三，生物伦理：人和动物。

shots.scene: 空白动物实验方案盖上伦理委员会印章
shots.prompt_en: A blank animal study protocol receives an ethics committee stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 动物实验，先过伦理审批。

shots.scene: 王老师向课题组讲解空白文件
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank document to a research team.
shots.narration: 批准内容要告诉全组，留好记录。

shots.scene: 动物、植物、昆虫、工厂、医院、基因六个图标
shots.prompt_en: Six icons: an animal, a plant, an insect, a factory, a hospital and a DNA strand. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十四，特殊领域要求更高。

shots.scene: 每个图标旁各有一本不同颜色的空白规章
shots.prompt_en: Each icon has a different colored blank rule book beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 各有专门法规，要不断补课。

shots.scene: 王老师在夜灯下读书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reads a book under a desk lamp at night.
shots.narration: 第二十五，持续学习。

shots.scene: 一份文件不断更新版本，页角数字增加
shots.prompt_en: A blank document with its version corner icon updating repeatedly. No people.
shots.narration: 安全员像一份“活文件”，常更新。

shots.section_title: 安全员靠什么发挥作用
shots.scene: 王老师站在中间，六个图标围绕
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands in the center surrounded by six icons.
shots.narration: 安全员能不能发挥作用，看六点。
overlay: 安全员靠什么发挥作用

shots.section_title: 安全员靠什么发挥作用
shots.scene: 领导握手、细胞、法规书三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a handshake, a cell and a law book. No people.
shots.narration: 领导支持，懂生物，懂法规。

shots.section_title: 安全员靠什么发挥作用
shots.scene: 设备、讲台、上升箭头三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: protective equipment, a podium and an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 懂工程和防护，会培训，肯改变。

shots.section_title: 安全员靠什么发挥作用
shots.scene: 王老师向全体人员讲话，大家认真听
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator speaks to the whole team and everyone listens carefully.
shots.narration: 政策靠沟通和培训，才能落地。

shots.section_title: 安全员靠什么发挥作用
shots.scene: 小研对照自己写的清单，补充了几条
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares her notebook list and adds a few items.
shots.narration: 对照开头写的清单，补一补吧。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现心形、规则本、清单三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a heart, a rule book and a checklist.
shots.narration: 文化靠以身作则，合规靠持续改进。

shots.scene: 王老师被一圈小图标环绕
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands surrounded by a ring of small duty icons.
shots.narration: 二十五项职责，从评估到培训。

shots.scene: 三张情景卡片排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three scenario cards in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 三个情景题，先问清再评估。

shots.scene: 阿杰主动把登记表交给王老师，两人握手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a completed blank form to the safety administrator and they shake hands.
shots.narration: 阿杰：原来安全员是来帮我们的。

shots.scene: 欣欣、王老师、小研和阿杰站在实验楼门口一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the safety administrator, the female graduate student and the young male student stand at a laboratory building entrance and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 安全有人管，人人都参与，再见！
